about.lead: I am a software engineer and product builder operating at the intersection of applied AI/ML, backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, and commercial product strategy.
paragraphs: I believe great products require more than accurate models. They require resilient backend architectures, cloud-native scalability, intuitive user workflows, and a sharp understanding of the business problems they solve.

My work spans the complete product lifecycle: from discovering customer friction and modeling unit economics to architecting distributed FastAPI services, orchestrating multi-agent LLM pipelines, and deploying containerized cloud infrastructure on AWS.

Whether building enterprise customer intelligence platforms like CampaignFlow or deploying clinical diagnostic frameworks with ROC-AUC 0.987, I build software that bridges engineering depth with measurable commercial impact.
